findings.diagnosis: BIG, 'Improve account access', is estimated at 6 days and combines a 3-day session-token verifier with an independent 3-day account-recovery UI. Bundling independently shippable concerns hides progress and makes one wait for the other.
findings.recommended_action: Consider splitting BIG into two 3-day tickets, one for the verifier and one for the recovery UI, so each can ship independently.
